title: ai_enrich can ground rows with external MCP search providers (Beta)
body:
The `ai_enrich` function can ground each row with a search tool on an external Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that you register in Unity Gateway, such as You.com or Exa. Add an `mcp` knowledge source alone or alongside other knowledge sources in the same call. This feature is in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). Workspace admins can enable the **Ai Enrich** preview from the [Previews](/aws/en/admin/workspace-settings/manage-previews) page.

See [MCP configuration](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/functions/ai_enrich#mcp-config).
